# Sea Secrets Hurghada — Business & Expedition Summary

> Sea Secrets Hurghada is a premier Red Sea boat trip and diving operator based in Hurghada, Egypt. Operating daily guided expeditions to islands, reefs, and dolphin lagoons since 1994.

## Business Details
- **Name**: Sea Secrets Hurghada
- **Address**: 50 Hurghada, Egypt, Hurghada 85411, Egypt
- **GPS Coordinates**: 27.1297151, 33.8307899
- **Primary Booking WhatsApp**: +20 111 089 0202
- **Secondary Contact**: +20 111 739 8388
- **Email**: info@sea-secret.com
- **Languages Supported**: English, German, Russian, Arabic, Italian, Polish, Czech, Ukrainian

## Daily Trips Offered (All 9:00 AM Departure unless noted)
1. **Hula Hula Island Sea Trip**: White sand beaches, crystal-clear shallows, 2 snorkeling stops, open buffet lunch on board.
2. **Magawish Island Sea Trip**: Golden sandbanks, turquoise waters, 2 snorkeling stops, fresh buffet lunch.
3. **Orange Island Sea Trip**: Shallow waters, iconic orange parasols, 2 snorkeling stops in Giftun archipelago.
4. **Deep Sea Diving Trip**: 2 guided scuba dives along coral walls with certified instructor. Snorkeling option for non-divers.
5. **Dolphin Sea Trip**: Swim with wild spinner dolphins at Dolphin House lagoon, 2 snorkeling stops.
6. **Paradise Island Sea Trip**: Giftun Islands National Park, white sand, teal lagoons, chance to see rays & sea turtles.
7. **Private Speedboat Trip**: 3-hour flexible private charter (up to 6 guests). Flexible route, skipper, snorkeling gear & refreshments included.

## Booking Method
All bookings and availability confirmations are processed instantly via WhatsApp at +20 111 089 0202 or through the official website at https://sea-secrets.com.
